Highlights from October 18-25, 2026: Loaded bounce extensions can now receive a native restart request for an idle session, without typing into the terminal.
Find and resume older sessions. Find Session now searches deeper conversation history after the initial matches, rather than stopping at recently ended sessions.
Move through visited sessions across projects with Back and Forward, including Command-[ and Command-] keyboard shortcuts.
Use your mouse's back and forward buttons to move through session history.
Right-click either navigation button to jump directly to one of the last ten visited sessions.
Keep your notifications focused: draft pull requests are hidden by default and no longer add to the notification badge while hidden.
The compact Hide menu keeps notification filtering controls steady instead of growing as more filters are selected.
Fixes and reliability: Previously loaded pull requests stay visible when one GitHub account fails to refresh, with a warning instead of an empty list. Temporary 502 errors get a short retry.
Inline images stay in chronological order with assistant replies, including after a session resume or app restart.
Removed obsolete launch flags so session startup and resume remain compatible with newer Copilot CLI versions.
Reduced misleading waiting and permission notifications caused by nested Copilot processes.
